### Eyewitnesses of Majesty
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/eyewitnesses-majesty
Passage: 2 Peter 1:16
Points:
- Christian behavior and the pursuit of holiness are deeply shaped by belief in Christ's return and final judgment.
- False teachers dismissed apostolic teaching as fabricated myths to rationalize their own immoral behavior.
- Peter refutes these accusations by testifying that the apostles were firsthand eyewitnesses of Jesus in His transfigured glory.
- The transfiguration confirmed Jesus' royal identity as the Davidic king prophesied to return in judgment.
- Trust in the second coming rests on verifiable historical events rather than invented human stories.

### The Morning Star of Hope
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-june-29-2025.html
Passage: 2 Peter 1:19
Points:
- Finite human beings cannot comprehend an infinite God unless He takes the initiative to reveal Himself.
- Scripture is not merely divine revelation; it actively illuminates the believer's understanding.
- The dark place represents the squalid, murky spiritual condition of the human heart prior to revelation.
- The Holy Spirit pulls back the curtain of skepticism and floods the soul with the light of Christ.
- Christians should continually heed God's Word and use its truth to encourage those wrestling with doubt.
